title: ParlAI Vote: A Web Platform for Analyzing Gender and Political Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparities in gender classification and vote prediction accuracy for female versus male speakers, using counterfactual demographic prompt manipulations, and analyzing model-generated reasoning to identify reliance on linguistic and topical stereotypes.

Measuring vote prediction accuracy across different political and ideological groups (e.g., centrist, far-right, far-left) and analyzing model reasoning to uncover flawed heuristics, keyword reliance, and misinterpretations of political rhetoric.
